title: Nova Stones
description: Adds many new decorative stone families with blocks, stairs, slabs, walls, stonecutting recipes, and world generation.
body:
Nova Stones adds a large collection of decorative stone families to Minecraft, including slate, marble, travertine, schist, gneiss, chert, alabaster, onyx, and many more.

Each family includes multiple block variants such as rough, smooth, polished, bricks, clean bricks, large bricks, stairs, slabs, and walls. Rough/base variants generate naturally in the world, while the other variants are obtained through stonecutting.

Built for NeoForge 1.21.1.
